messages.text: I asked earlier but failed to see the response before I inadvertently closed the window.  If I order qty 2 of the Hammer Miner BC04's, will I have them in hand by Thanksgiving?
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner BC04

No problem, here's the answer again. If you're in the US, yes, very likely. The BC04 is in stock and ships within 2 business days, so if you order today the pair should leave by Thursday, November 19. That gives the carrier a full week before Thanksgiving on the 26th.

I can't promise the exact delivery day. That depends on your address and the shipping option you pick at checkout. They're $215 each right now, so $430 for two.

This link takes you to checkout with two already in the cart: https://heliumdeploy.myshopify.com/cart/48819999441151:2
